defective_pattern: Dumping inline feature labels followed by colons (e.g. جنسیت: ..., پایه تحصیلی: ...) inside academic paragraphs instead of continuous discourse.
why_defective: Replaces cohesive, professional narrative synthesis with telegraphic, slideshow-like bulleting disguised as prose, violating institutional high-quality writing standards.
observed_symptoms: Frequent use of bolded words followed by colons inside body paragraphs
Absence of narrative transitions between variables
corrective_remedy: Transform label-colon pairs into continuous scholarly narrative using transitional connectives (در ارزیابی تفاوت‌های جنسیتی، ... در ادامه، بررسی متغیر پایه تحصیلی نشان داد ... سرانجام، در خصوص نوع مدرسه، ...).

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: High density of colons (:) following short phrase prefixes within standard academic paragraphs.
